idea-plugin.name: Billable
idea-plugin.description:
Run every project on the right Claude account, and always know which one you are on.

Freelancers and consultants often hold a Claude account per client, plus a personal one. Claude Code signs in once per config directory, so it is easy to spend a client's quota on your own project, or lose track of what a session costs. Billable puts the account, the usage and the switch in the status bar.

  • The account in the status bar: the account this folder runs on, the latest session's tokens and cost, and the highest rate-limit usage. It turns amber at 90% of a limit.
  • Switch in one click: the choice is saved per folder, so each project keeps its own account.
  • Cost report by account: what each account, and each folder under it, cost in a month, with CSV export for invoices.
  • The terminal follows: one shell function makes claude in the IDE terminal start on the folder's account.
  • Sign-ins that end: a Claude sign-in has a fixed end and cannot be renewed after it. Billable asks claude auth status for each account, turns red when one is signed out, warns three days before, and signs it in again in an IDE terminal.

Works with the companion Claude Code plugin multi-account and shares its setup with the Billable extension for VS Code. Everything stays on your machine. Not affiliated with Anthropic.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0

  • A sign-in that ended shows as signed out. Claude Code keeps the email in .claude.json after a sign-in ends, so the account looked signed in while every conversation on it stopped with a sign-in prompt. Billable now asks claude auth status for each account (every ten minutes, sooner for a signed-out one, and right after a sign-in) and believes that over the email. The status bar turns red with <account> signed out, and one notification offers to sign in again or switch the folder to an account that still works.
  • A warning three days before a sign-in ends: the status bar shows the time left, and a notification once a day offers to sign in again before.
  • The switch menu marks an account that is signed out, or whose sign-in ends soon. An account that never signed in reads "not signed in"; "signed out" only once claude said so.
  • New action Tools | Billable | Sign In to an Account Again: runs claude auth login for the account in an IDE terminal, with the link printed instead of opening the default browser (usually signed in to another Claude account).
  • The checks are kept in ~/.claude-multi-account/auth.json, shared with the VS Code extension and the Claude Code plugin. An answer about another folder than the one asked is ignored.
  • Switching to an account that is not signed in offers the sign-in first (or Switch anyway): a new conversation there would ask to sign in through the default browser, which usually authorizes another Claude account.
  • Two accounts on one sign-in are flagged: when two accounts are signed in as the same Claude account, the tooltip says so and a notification offers to sign either one in again.
  • The status bar agrees with the launcher: a folder without a rule (or whose rule names an account that is not listed) shows the account on ~/.claude, not the first account of the file or the last session's; a project opened through a link takes the rule of its real path too.
  • The account files are read like the launchers read them: a BOM, CRLF line endings, and a name listed twice keeps its first line. A relative CLAUDE_MULTI_ACCOUNT_HOME is taken from the home folder.
  • A switch replaces the folders file in one step. 999,999 tokens read 1.0M, not 1000K.
  • The status bar shows the email the account is signed in as now, not the one of its last session.
  • Refresh also asks claude about every account at once.
